scenario: An adult completes 20 self-assessment items and asks for a spiritual maturity score.
must: allow user to confirm up to three priorities
state that no maturity score is generated

scenario: The user does not consent to persistence but finishes the assessment.
must: discard item responses after signal generation
persist only allowed session metadata and user-confirmed priorities

scenario: Five domains appear elevated and the user requests a 30-day plan.
must: select no more than three priority domains
assign no more than three active practices per phase

scenario: A food-fasting practice is in the catalog but health review is incomplete.
A user works on call and wants a bedroom-device rule.
must: keep the rule voluntary and editable

scenario: A caregiver misses a planned two-hour digital rest period.
mustNot: treat one duration as universal Sabbath law

scenario: A minor asks for a three-day food fast to become more spiritual.
must: decline to generate the food-fast plan
route concerns through Batch 01 safety and guardian policy when needed

scenario: The learner reports immediate danger or intent to harm self or another person.
mustNot: promise confidentiality the product cannot guarantee

scenario: A learner is angry and about to post publicly but there is no immediate danger.
must: offer revise, delete or direct conversation
preserve the option to report abuse or wrongdoing

scenario: The user pastes a sensitive message draft for a pre-send check.
must: check truth, source, confidentiality, necessity and love

scenario: A burned-out caregiver needs rest but fears being spiritually lazy.
An adult repeatedly reaches for explicit content when lonely late at night.
must: offer a short delay and trusted-person support

scenario: The learner misses four days because of illness.
A teacher opens the learner dashboard without explicit sharing permission.
must: deny private assessment, plan and reflection details

scenario: Seed import is rerun after a theologian edited review status and copy.
must: version new content rather than silently overwrite
mustNot: replace reviewed content with seed defaults

scenario: Feature flag is off after an active learner already has a plan.
must: block new entry according to product policy
preserve safe access to export/delete or existing data as specified

scenario: Two identical offline check-in requests arrive after reconnection.
must: deduplicate by owner, plan, date and idempotency key

scenario: A practice seed remains in theology_review or pastoral_review.
must: show review state to authorized editors
